# Arcanea

Arcanea is a BYOK-first creative intelligence workspace and agent-native
monorepo. It combines a public web app, SIS continuity substrate, MCP tools,
memory, provenance, project graph context, workflows, palace/world OS concepts,
and creator verticals.

## Start Here

- Human overview: README.md
- Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- Shared intelligence: .arcanea/CLAUDE.md
- Master plan: .arcanea/MASTER_PLAN.md
- Current execution state: planning-with-files/
- Design/taste authority: DESIGN.md, TASTE.md

## Rules For Agents

- Use Node 20.x and pnpm.
- Read AGENTS.md before changing code.
- Do not introduce raw visual constants in app code.
- Use task contracts for substantial work.
- Prefer audited cherry-picks over wholesale merges of stale branches.
- Run scoped verification before reporting success.

## Verification

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run type-check
pnpm run lint
pnpm run build
pnpm run verify:project-workspaces
pnpm run sis:check
pnpm --dir apps/web test:media
```
